summary: Mineral Lake tower, Ashland County, built about 1933, likely by the CCC; the FFLA Wisconsin list marks it gone. No source found on its removal or the site today.

facts.status_note: The FFLA Wisconsin list (cite 2) marks the tower as gone. No source read gives a removal date.
facts.agency: Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources (administering agency per FFLOS)

events.note: Built circa 1933, likely by the CCC, along Camp Six Creek in Chequamegon-Nicolet National Forest

evidence.supports: built circa 1933, likely by the CCC

resolved_conflicts.explanation: FFLOS gives N 46.28306, W 90.79750. The OpenStreetMap point sits at 46.2843959, -90.8010181, about 300 m away. The record keeps the FFLOS coordinates.

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLOS detail page gives history, and it has no removal date, no staffing and no fires. The CCC link is 'likely' per FFLOS; the WHS camp record does not tie the camp to the tower. OSM point may be stale. No source found on the site today or on access. Brief's record matches the FFLOS page.
